text: Agile methodology is a popular way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, which is a list of user stories describing what users need. Every day, team members hold short meetings called standups to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to test their work regularly, get feedback, and make improvements quickly. As a result, Agile helps teams respond to change and deliver value faster.
